description: This file defines the MealProvider class, which manages meal data and interactions with the database for a diet planner application using Flutter. It includes methods for setting dates, refreshing daily and weekly data, adding, and deleting meal items, and notifies listeners upon data updates.

classes.name: MealProvider
classes.description: A provider class extending ChangeNotifier to manage meal data and state within a Flutter app.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the selected date and notifies listeners.

methods.name: refreshDay
methods.description: Fetches and updates the meal data and total calories for the selected day.

methods.name: refreshWeek
methods.description: Fetches and updates the weekly calorie summary for the selected week.

methods.name: addItem
methods.description: Adds a new meal item to the database and refreshes daily and weekly data.

methods.name: deleteItem
methods.description: Deletes a meal item from the database and refreshes data.
